name: Unconnected conductor crossing
summary: An unconnected crossing shows conductors passing across each other in the drawing without an electrical junction.
description: An unconnected crossing shows conductors passing across each other in the drawing without an electrical junction. The wires overlap in the two-dimensional page layout but remain distinct circuits. A gap or bridge/loop makes that distinction visible where the selected drawing convention uses one.
Check both the displayed graphic and the CAD network topology. A crossing must not acquire an unintended junction when drawing segments are moved or edited.
readingNotes: Apply the selected gap or loop convention consistently and check that no connection node is created.
A gap or bridge is a drafting convention, not a physical cable crossover dimension.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Apply the selected gap or loop convention consistently and check that no connection node is created.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A gap or bridge is a drafting convention, not a physical cable crossover dimension.
